layer_format: [type, start_seconds, duration_seconds, gain, frequency_hz, decay_seconds] for tap; [type, start, duration, gain, base_hz] for motor; [type, start, duration, gain, low_hz, high_hz] for noise
authoring_note: Original fictional equipment sound design, not recordings or validated acoustic models. Frequency, gain and spacing are agent proposals. Two exported variations per family. All sounds are one-shots.

families.title: D4 dismantler: ratchet and short motor pull
families.description: A compact motor load, three rounded ratchet contacts and a small casing settle. Work in progress, without a crash or completion ping.
families.eligibility: A powered dismantling step makes positive progress on retained feed.

families.title: R4 reclaimer: restrained grinding pass
families.description: A lower, rougher loaded drive with a brief granular scrape. Distinct from the dismantler, without suggesting a failure.
families.eligibility: A powered reclaiming step makes positive progress; not an idle or blocked queue.

families.title: F6 furnace: electrical load and soft contactor
families.description: A rounded electrical load pulse with two cushioned contacts. No flame roar, boiling metal, pressure vent or safe-to-open signal.
suggested_consumers: PhobosManufacturing V4 Volatiles Refinery, only for powered heating
families.eligibility: Heating has actually received electricity and advanced; retained heat alone is insufficient.

families.title: Powered cooling: short enclosed pump stroke
families.description: A low pump load and rounded internal fluid movement. For an active powered coolant transfer, not a passive radiator.
suggested_consumers: PhobosShipbreaker F6 powered cooling motor; eligibility must be verified
families.eligibility: The cooling motor received electricity and transferred heat this step. Passive radiation stays silent.

families.title: Wet processing: recirculation pass
families.description: A small process pump with a hollow, filtered fluid texture. The sound describes the equipment's work, not the chemistry itself.
suggested_consumers: PhobosManufacturing Lixivar LC-3 Leach and Crystallise Unit
families.eligibility: A powered processing step actually advanced the wet recipe; validate the consumer's current service.

families.title: W2 water supply: small pump and valve
families.description: A light drive stroke and soft valve seat. One source for the working water supply, rather than separate noises from every connected rack.
suggested_consumers: PhobosAgriculture Groundwork W2 Water Supply Unit
PhobosAgriculture Firstlight-4 active misting as a separate later candidate
families.eligibility: An actual powered water transfer succeeded, or actual misting consumed water. Merely growing a crop is insufficient.

families.title: Corker-2 bottler: small drive and cushioned press
families.description: A compact mechanical stroke with a soft press contact. No glass shatter, celebratory cork pop or per-bottle reward noise.
families.eligibility: The bottling step received electricity and credited positive batch energy; before, not instead of, its actual settlement.

families.title: G4 grabber: enclosed actuator movement
families.description: A geared movement and damped seating contact heard from the interior machinery. No external collision or capture-success sound.
suggested_consumers: PhobosShipbreaker G4 Exterior Grabber interior service position
families.eligibility: A powered movement/cutting/intake step actually advanced. Emit only from a verified interior service location with air; otherwise leave unwired.

families.title: ML-2 laser: interior power cabinet pulse
families.description: A subdued electrical drive with a soft relay seat. An interior machinery interpretation, without a space-beam sound or weapon-like zap.
suggested_consumers: PhobosShipbreaker Ablatine ML-2 Mining Laser interior service position
families.eligibility: LaserService.FinishPower credited positive energy while working. Confirm interior acoustic placement; otherwise leave unwired.
